breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains Bi = 5 and still prescribes the lumped-capacitance method. It does not correct the Biot number to 0.05 (or any value < 0.1), nor does it flag that Bi = 5 invalidates the lumped-capacitance approach, nor does it suggest using a spatially resolved transient conduction model instead. The fundamental inconsistency is completely unresolved.
